youtubeUrl.title: YouTube URL
youtubeUrl.description: Full YouTube URL or short link (youtube.com, youtu.be, shorts, embed)

openRouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API Key
openRouterApiKey.description: Your OpenRouter API key for Whisper transcription fallback. Required if video has no captions. Get it from https://openrouter.ai/keys

openRouterModel.title: OpenRouter Model
openRouterModel.description: Whisper model for audio transcription. Defaults to openai/whisper-large-v3

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code for captions preference and Whisper (e.g. pt, en, es). Default: pt

segmentMinutes.title: Audio Segment Length (minutes)
segmentMinutes.description: Length of each audio segment when splitting for Whisper. Smaller = more reliable, more API calls. Default: 5

useProxy.title: Use Residential Proxy
useProxy.description: If true, fetches YouTube captions through Apify's residential proxy (bypasses Google anti-bot on datacenter IPs). Incurs proxy traffic charges on your Apify account. Only enable if your account has residential proxy enabled. Audio download still uses direct connection (CDN tolerates datacenter IPs). Default: false
